title: Get parameter rule for MEMBER search results "&parentid=123" | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Get parameter rule for MEMBER search results "&parentid=123" Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000070467 Member search results can be filtered by adding the parentid parameter to the search results URL. This returns sub-account members assigned to the specified parent member ID. URL Format Use the following URL structure: Copy /search_results?parentid=123 Replace 123 with the parent member's User ID. Find the Parent Member ID To locate a member's User ID, see: How to View a Member's Unique ID Number in the Admin Area Example If the parent member's User ID is 18 , the search results URL would be: Copy /search_results?parentid=18 The search results page will then display members assigned as sub-accounts of that parent member. How To View A Member's Unique ID Number In The Admin Area For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
